parties.respondent: M/s. Green Edge Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Pre-referral jurisdiction under Section 11(6) of Arbitration Act; existence vs validity of arbitration agreement; Section 11(6A) requires referral court to conclusively determine existence of arbitration agreement before referral; reference to arbitration improper when existence of agreement disputed; reliance on N.N. Global Mercantile (2023) and NTPC Ltd. (2023); High Court erred in treating arbitrability as sole issue without resolving existence of arbitration clause; SHA-1, SHA-2, MOU-1 and MOU-2 interconnectedness contested.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order referring disputes to arbitration set aside; remanded for determination on existence of arbitration agreement.
